tools.name: suggest_source
tools.description: Tell My Noticeboard where local community activity is announced: the address of a group’s own website, a parish, library or venue programme, or an iCal feed. We read the page ourselves; nothing is published on your word. Community-led and voluntary activity only. Needs an API key. Returns a receipt;

tools.name: suggest_listing
tools.description: Tell My Noticeboard about one local community group, service, event or useful leaflet, citing the public page that announces it (source_url). A curator checks it against that page before anything is published. Community-led and voluntary activity, charities and public services only; not businesses.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Find community groups, charities and support services by need and place. Returns ranked listings with distance and when each was last checked. Search reach is a discovery hint, not proof of catchment or eligibility.

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Full details for one service: description, how to get help, contacts, opening times, address and when it was last checked.

tools.name: get_whats_on
tools.description: Sessions and activities happening at a time and place. Accepts a plain-English question such as "what can I do today in Bridport?" or "what's on next week for housebound people?". Cancelled dates are included and marked.

tools.name: get_resource_sheet
tools.description: A ready-made set of the best local, area-wide and national services plus resources for one topic, as a link worker would print.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The topics (themes and the needs under them) used to tag listings. Codes work as the topic for get_resource_sheet.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: suggest_source · Private data: suggest_source, suggest_listing, get_service · Public sink: suggest_listing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: suggest_source · Private data: suggest_source, suggest_listing, get_service · Public sink: suggest_listing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find community groups, charities and support services by need and place. Returns ranked listings with distance and when each was last checked." → after: "Find community groups, charities and support services by need and place. Returns ranked listings with distance and when each was last checked. Search reach is a discovery hint, not proof of catchment or eligibility."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
